summary: Frontend regression test for (a) org member routes and (b) Get-the-app freeze fix. FAILED at the very first step: the entire app renders a blank page on every route due to a JavaScript ReferenceError 'appOpen is not defined' thrown by <Layout>. None of the 5 requested checks can pass in this state.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: 'appOpen is not defined' thrown at Layout render — whole app is blank on every URL (/, /organisation/member/login, /organisation/member/redeem, /nonsense-xyz). Console: 'pageerror: appOpen is not defined' + React 'An error occurred in the <Layout> component'.

integration_issues.issue: State `appOpen`/`setAppOpen` is declared inside the `LaunchNotice` component (line 100) but is referenced in three places OUTSIDE its scope: Navbar desktop button (line 536: `onClick={() => setAppOpen(true)}`), Navbar mobile button (line 858: `setAppOpen(true)`), and Layout root (line 1593: `<GetAppDialog open={appOpen} onOpenChange={setAppOpen} />`). These identifiers are undefined at those scopes, so the module builds but crashes at render.

check_results.catchall_redirect_unknown_path: FAIL (blank page; URL not redirected — Router never mounted because Layout crashed)
check_results.get_app_dialog_open_then_close_freeze_fi: FAIL (trigger not present because whole page is blank)

action_items: URGENT: Lift `appOpen`/`setAppOpen` state OUT of `LaunchNotice` and into a scope shared by Navbar, LaunchNotice, and the Layout root. Recommended: create a small context (e.g., `GetAppContext`) with `{open, setOpen}` provided in `Layout`, and consumed by `Navbar` (both desktop `data-testid='get-app-trigger-desktop'` and mobile trigger) and by `<GetAppDialog>`. Alternatively, declare `const [appOpen, setAppOpen] = useState(false);` inside the `Layout` component itself and pass `onOpenApp={() => setAppOpen(true)}` as a prop to `<Navbar/>`, then use that prop on both the desktop and mobile buttons; render `<GetAppDialog open={appOpen} onOpenChange={setAppOpen}/>` from Layout as it already does.
After fix, re-run the 5 checks in the review request. The freeze fix cannot be verified until the app renders.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx (1603 lines) is far above the 700-line guideline — split Navbar, Footer, LaunchNotice, InstallPrompt, DemoTour, AdminSignInDialog into their own files. Would also have prevented this scoping bug.
No React error boundary around <Layout>: a single ReferenceError takes the whole site down. Add an ErrorBoundary at the root so at minimum a fallback UI shows.

State ownership rule: any state consumed by more than one sibling/parent component (like Get-the-app dialog open state) must live in a shared parent or context, not in an unrelated leaf component (LaunchNotice).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The single blocker is the `appOpen is not defined` ReferenceError in /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.jsx. The offending references are at lines 536, 858, and 1593; the state is (wrongly) declared at line 100 inside `LaunchNotice`. Once main agent lifts the state, re-run: (1) visit /organisation/member/login and assert [data-testid='org-member-login-page']; (2) visit /organisation/member/redeem and assert body has content; (3) visit /nonsense-xyz and assert page.url ends with '/'; (4) on '/', click [data-testid='get-app-trigger-desktop'] → assert [data-testid='get-app-dialog'] is visible → press Escape → assert dialog hidden AND `getComputedStyle(document.body).pointerEvents !== 'none'` AND a nav link is clickable (freeze fix); (5) no console errors.
rca of the issue: RCA: When refactoring Get-the-app to un-nest the Radix dialog from the mobile menu overlay, main agent added `<GetAppDialog open={appOpen} onOpenChange={setAppOpen}/>` at the Layout root (line 1593) and added `setAppOpen(true)` callbacks to Navbar buttons (lines 536, 858), but declared the `useState` for `appOpen` inside the unrelated `LaunchNotice` function component (line 100). Because JS lexical scoping, those three outer references are undefined at runtime → ReferenceError on Layout render → whole app blank on every route. Reproduction: visit any URL on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL; observe blank page and console `pageerror: appOpen is not defined`. Mitigation: lift the state to Layout (or a shared context) and thread it to Navbar via props/context; see action_items.
